titulo_original: Notes on Colombia, Taken in the Years 1822-3, with an Itinerary of the Route from Caracas to Bogotá
edicion_consultada: Original English edition (1827), Library of Congress / Internet Archive
tramo_principal: Facatativá / Alto del Trigo / Villeta / Guaduas / Casa Coronel Acosta / Alto del Sargento / Honda
notas_criticas: Registered as 'Baché' in initial matrix; corrected to Richard Bache. Documents votive crosses, road steps, and mule load weights (250 lbs).

titulo_original: Voyage dans la République de Colombia, en 1823
edicion_consultada: Spanish translation: Viaje por la República de Colombia en 1823 (Bogotá: Biblioteca Popular de Cultura Colombiana, 1944)
tramo_principal: Honda / Mariquita / Río Seco / Venta Grande / Alto del Sargento / Guaduas / Villeta / Bogotá
notas_criticas: Documents early republican muleteering, human porters carrying chicha jars, road width (15 varas), and Venta Grande at 908 toises.

titulo_original: Voyage pittoresque dans les deux Amériques: résumé général de tous les voyages
edicion_consultada: Original French edition (1836 / 1853), Bibliothèque nationale de France
tramo_principal: Mompox / Honda / Venta Grande / Alto del Sargento / Guaduas / Villeta / El Curador / Bogotá
notas_criticas: High material density (pelacas, samaros, Venta Grande layout, milestones at El Curador), but exhibits intertextual overlap with contemporary travelers; not treated as statistically independent where passages coincide verbatim.

titulo_original: Narratives of South America; Illustrating Manners, Customs, and Scenery
edicion_consultada: Original English edition (1836), Biblioteca Luis Ángel Arango
tramo_principal: Honda / Río Gualí / Valle de Villeta / Rustic Corridor / Bogotá
notas_criticas: Contains the densest domestic kitchen inventory in the corpus (16 material items), telescopic leather petucas, and the ruined colonial bridge over the Gualí River in Honda.

titulo_original: Bogota in 1836-7: Being a Narrative of an Expedition to the Capital of New-Granada, and a Residence There of Eleven Months
edicion_consultada: Original English edition (1838), Harvard University / New York Public Library
tramo_principal: Río Magdalena / Puerto Nare / Bodegas / Honda / Guaduas / Cune / Villeta / El Aserradero / Facatativá
notas_criticas: Registered as 'Stuart' in initial matrix. Detailed descriptions of Bodegas architecture, 250-lb load regulations, Guaduas straw hats, and roadside ventas.

titulo_original: Voyages et séjours dans l'Amérique du Sud: la Nouvelle-Grenade, Santiago de Cuba, la Jamaïque et l'isthme de Panama
edicion_consultada: Spanish translation: Viajes y estancias en América del Sur (Bogotá: Biblioteca Popular de Cultura Colombiana, 1945)
tramo_principal: Honda / Alto del Sargento / Guaduas / Villeta / Facatativá / Sabana de Bogotá
notas_criticas: Residence in New Granada spanned 1828-1839; published in Paris in 1880. Documents Honda stores, almofrej bull-hide bedding bags, crude iron cutlery, mutton ajiaco, and Sabana causeways.

titulo_original: Peregrinación de Alpha por las provincias del norte de la Nueva Granada, en 1850 i 51
editorial: Imprenta de Echeverría Hermanos (reissued 1984, Biblioteca Banco Popular)
edicion_consultada: 1853 / 1984 Spanish editions, Biblioteca Luis Ángel Arango
tramo_principal: Bogotá / Zipaquirá / Chiquinquirá / Socorro / Vélez (Northern Provinces route)
tipo_documento: Chorographic Commission Travelogue (Diario de la Comisión Corográfica)
notas_criticas: Retained with explicit comparative flag: although the itinerary follows the northern highland routes rather than Honda-Bogotá, it provides the most precise architectural and material descriptions of mid-19th-century New Granadan roadside ventas.

titulo_original: New Granada: Twenty Months in the Andes
tramo_principal: Bodegas de Bogotá / Pescaderías / Honda / Alto del Sargento / Guaduas / El Raizal / Cune / Villeta / Mave / Salitre / Chimbe / Escobal (Agualarga) / Facatativá
notas_criticas: Crucial source for lexical distinctions (carriel, mochila, talego, guambia), bamboo tarros, fractional coinage (cuartillo, medio, real, apatacón), tiple and alfandoque, and the Villeta-Mave-Salitre-Chimbe road segment.

titulo_original: Relação de uma viagem a Venezuela, Nova Granada e Equador
edicion_consultada: Original Portuguese edition (1866), Bibliothèque nationale de France
tramo_principal: Vuelta de Madre de Dios / Pescaderías / Honda / Sargento / Guaduas / Alto del Trigo / Cune / Petaquero / Villeta / Salitre / Chimbe / Facatativá
notas_criticas: Documents wooden saddle fustes, brass shoe-stirrups, lead glazing mines ('alcohol') near Villeta/Salitre, pack oxen with cangalhas/alforjas, and grand pianos carried by human porters.

titulo_original: Impresiones de un viaje a América. Tomo X: Excursión a Mariquita del 27 de mayo al 4 de junio de 1874
editorial: Manuscript / Digital Edition, Biblioteca Luis Ángel Arango
edicion_consultada: Digitalized Spanish manuscript and transcript, Banco de la República
tramo_principal: Bogotá / El Aserradero / Facatativá / Villeta / Guaduas / Honda / Mariquita
notas_criticas: Documents leather zurrones for ore transport on oxen, plantain leaves used as plates, porters carrying pianos through mud, and cucambas (calabash rattles) in Corpus Christi festivities.

titulo_original: La Nouvelle-Grenade et les anciennes colonies espagnoles de l'Amérique du Sud
tramo_principal: Bodegas / Guaduas / Villeta / Puerto del Salitre / Agualarga / Facatativá / Bogotá
tipo_documento: Travelogue and economic treatise (Diario y memoria económica)
notas_criticas: Unifies entries previously listed as anonymous ('Osorio 1875') and 'Rolland 1875'. Documents 45-degree paved stone steps at Salitre, rope-and-winch river crossings, ceiba wood troughs (l'arteza), and high resale value of empty European glass bottles.

editorial: Le Tour du Monde (Hachette, 1883) / América Pintoresca (Montaner y Simón, 1884)
edicion_consultada: Spanish translation in América Pintoresca (1884, trad. C. Nava) and Colombia 1876 (trad. P. Nava Sanz de Santamaría, Uniandes)
tramo_principal: Honda / Caracolí / Bodegas de Bogotá / Pescaderías / Venta de las Cruces / Sargento / Guaduas / Raizal / Cune / Petaquero / Villeta / Facatativá
notas_criticas: High material density on riding gear (galápago, jáquima, sudadero, zamarros), tarpaulin encerados, lexical distinction between carrial, mochila/talega, guambia, and petaca, bamboo tarros for guarapo, and clay múcuras with cow-horn funnels.

titulo_original: My First Trip up the Magdalena, and Life in the Heart of the Andes
editorial: Journal of the American Geographical Society of New York, Vol. 9, pp. 126-141
tramo_principal: Río Magdalena / Honda / Guaduas / Villeta / Alto del Roble / El Aserradero / Bogotá
notas_criticas: Synthesizes multiple journeys between 1847 and 1877. Documents portable hammocks and oversized cargo crates unsuitable for mules.

tramo_principal: Honda / Posada El Consuelo / Alto del Sargento / Guaduas / Villeta / Chimbe / Agualarga / Alto del Roble / Bogotá
notas_criticas: Only South American (Argentine) diplomat in the corpus. Rich descriptions of guadua parihuelas, abandoned pianos and steam boilers on the trail, spare alpargatas worn at the belt, Posada El Consuelo layout and guestbook, and the only bed with sheets in Chimbe.

edicion_consultada: Spanish translation: Viajes por los Andes colombianos (1882-1884), trad. H. Henk (Bogotá: Banco de la República, 1976)
tramo_principal: Honda / Posada El Tocuí / El Consuelo / Guaduas / Villeta / Chimbe / Agualarga / Los Manzanos / Bogotá
notas_criticas: Misattributed to 'Wilhelm Reiss' in initial NotebookLM extraction; restored to Alfred Hettner (1976 [1882-1884]). Documents El Tocuí posada architecture, ox-hide cujas, rusted rails of Brown's failed Western Colombian Railway, collapsed iron bridges, and 'paso de buey' mud ridges.

titulo_original: A Flying Trip to the Tropics: A Record of an Ornithological Visit to the United States of Colombia, South America and to the Island of Curaçao, West Indies, in the Year 1892
tramo_principal: Honda / Guaduas / Villeta / Chimbe / Agualarga / Facatativá / Bogotá
notas_criticas: Incorporated in Stage 1 audit. Documents raw-hide patacas, coarse netting bags for earthenware, stone counterweights on mules, annatto/garlic seasoning, tiple and bandola double-coursed strings, destroyed pillow-sized stone paving, and animal bones along the road.

titulo_original: Up the Orinoco and Down the Magdalena
notas_criticas: Incorporated in Stage 1 audit. Documents McClellan-like galápago saddles, brass shoe-shaped stirrups, bronze rowel espuelas, goatskin zamoros, and woven palm crosses erected on May 3 against wind squalls.
